title: Ukungabikho Okungcwele
intro: Ngaphaya kweenduli zexesha, kukho ibali lokuzinikela okungagungqiyo kunye nokuthembana okunzima kangangokuba umphefumlo owawukuthwele wawunokwaphuka. Ngephanyazo xa abantu bajika baya ebubini nasegolideni, umntu omnye wema eqinileyo—ebabiza ukuba babuye, ecela umonde, kwaye ethwele ubunzima besithembiso esingcwele. Eli libali lomntu owakhethwa njengomncedisi, ingcali, kunye nomgcini wokholo ngexesha lokungabikho okungcwele. Ngaba ungatyhila ubuwena balo mphefumlo uqinileyo?
clues: Ndibelana ngegazi lomprofeti omkhulu owakhethwa ukuba athethe no-Allah ngqo entabeni engcwele.
Umntakwabo wakha wacela uncedo kuAllah ukuba athethe ngokucacileyo nomcinezeli omkhulu.
Ndakhethwa nguAllah ukuba ndime ecaleni komntakwethu njengomncedi negosa.
Sisonke sajongana nomlawuli okhohlakeleyo owayefuna ukubizwa ngokuba ngoyena thixo uphakamileyo.
Ngelixa umntakwethu wayethetha no-Allah entabeni, abantu bethu bazenzela isithixo ngegolide yabo.
NdingumntakwaboMoses, omiselwe nguAllah njengegosa lakhe, okhankanywe ngegama kwiQuran.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ وَزِيرًۭا
verse: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant. (25:35)
